summary: Choice Hotels International filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $500 million senior unsecured term loan credit agreement with Wells Fargo as administrative agent. The term loan matures August 28, 2029, with a one-year extension option subject to lender consent and customary conditions. Interest is SOFR plus 1.25% or base rate plus 0.25%. Covenants include leverage and fixed charge coverage ratios, with the coverage covenant waived if investment-grade. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including working capital. This is a routine debt facility, not a special situation, so it is classified as None.
